title: One Word:
title_q: “If You Had to Describe Your Job in One Word”
title_short: One Word Job Description · Staff montage
headline: CASS staff each describe their job in one word, opening on the CEO: lead, catalyst, fulfilling, compliance, ever changing, rewarding.
story: The structure is fixed by the client: open on Nathan so his answer carries the weight, then cut to the rest of the staff (approved on the 17 Sep call).
Nathan thinks, smiles, and lands on <q>lead</q>, with one line of why. Then fast: one face, one word, one name super each. Two <q>Rewarding</q> answers back to back close it.
Every answer already exists on tape: the same question was asked in the October interviews and the July staff interviews.
do: Open on Nathan, then the staff.
One face and one word per cut. About 3 s each.
Name super on every person, lower left, above the captions.
Cut out the crew talk around each answer.
dont: No residents or children on screen.
No figures from Nathan's longer answer.
Do not use takes where the person looks away from the camera.
No logo before the end card.

decisions.t: Cut now or wait for Zsirai's pickups?
decisions.b: The item says not shot, but Nathan, Nicole, Gabriela and Richard (October) and Lucinda, Janet, Crystal and Bri (July) all answered this question on camera. Zsirai still plans more staff in a made-up studio. Nick to decide: cut now with these eight, or wait and add the pickups.
On camera he says “regional executive director” and chose not to call himself doctor. His own Post Production item says “Dr. Richard Southee · Former CEO, CASS”. Zsirai to confirm.
The July files spell it Diodata and Diodato. The super uses Janet only until Zsirai confirms.
